fields.name: sample accession
fields.description: the IGVF accession. this can be a comma separated list

fields.name: sample description
fields.description: Lab alias or English definition of the sample. this can be a comma separated list

fields.name: position
fields.description: Optional for use with complex barcoding systems,  position is the zero based array offset location of the start of the sample identifying barcode sequence

fields.name: parse barcode type
fields.description: Optional for parse seq (R for random or T for poly-A primed)
